title: Themes
intro: A theme can change how znote looks, add page templates, or both. The switches on a theme decide whether its look and its templates are offered; pick the look to use from the list above.
storeFailure: {reason} Themes you already installed are shown below.

contents.both: Changes the look and adds page templates

lookSwitchTitle: Show this theme in the list of looks
templatesSwitchTitle: Show this theme's templates when you pick a template
